_comment: Drives both menus: the mobile OSD in components/retro-menu.tsx and the desktop marquee in components/marquee-menu.tsx. The deck/mode/clock values are the on-screen-display chrome of a 1986 VCR; 'clock' is 12:00 on purpose - an unset VCR blinking 12:00 is the era's signature. Adding or reordering an item is an edit here, not a code change. Channel numbers are NOT stored: they are derived from what is actually on screen, so hiding an item (Videos, until media exists) renumbers the rest instead of leaving a gap at CH 03. An item has EITHER an 'href' (it navigates) OR 'expands' (it opens a sub-list); Books expands, and its titles come from lib/books.ts so the menu can't drift from the catalog.

osd.hint: Use ↑ ↓ to browse · Enter to select · Esc to close
